Generic.Int64.name: Generic.Int64
Generic.Int64.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.

Generic.JSON.name: Generic.JSON
Generic.JSON.description: Any valid JSON value: object, array, primitive, or null

Identity.UUID.name: Identity.UUID
Identity.UUID.description: UUID v4 with automatic base62 encoding for client-facing APIs

Temporal.DateTime.name: Temporal.DateTime
Temporal.DateTime.description: ISO8601 datetime string. Epoch wire values keep this scalar and declare x-temporal-format (unix, unix_millis, unix_micros, unix_nanos) on the property; the unit is never guessed from digit count.

Review.name: Review
Review.comment:
A review's conversation of refs and code blocks alone, its bodies at
most 2000 code points, pinned and resolved by the permissions it names.

ReviewCommentsConversations.name: ReviewCommentsConversations
ReviewCommentsConversations.comment: On a table, one row per row that has had a message, kept for the table as a whole: the greatest message id, reaction number and stand the row's conversation has given. Every write of a conversation moves its row's version, which holds two writes of one conversation apart; a delete of the row leaves it, so a row re-created with the key numbers on from it and never reuses an id.

fields.name: conversation
fields.description: The key of the row whose conversation it is.

fields.name: lastMessage
fields.description: The greatest message id the conversation has given.

fields.name: lastReaction
fields.description: The greatest reaction number the conversation has given.

fields.name: lastStand
fields.description: The greatest stand the conversation has given.

ReviewCommentsEdits.name: ReviewCommentsEdits
ReviewCommentsEdits.comment: On a table, one row per edit of a message, keyed by the message and the edit's number: what the message held before the edit, who made it and when. A delete or a purge of the message deletes them, and so does a delete of the row.

fields.name: review
fields.description: The Review row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: edit
fields.description: The message's id and the edit's number on it, each in ten digits zero-padded, joined by a dot, so the key's order is theirs.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The id of the message edited.

fields.name: number
fields.description: The edit's number on the message, from 1.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The body before the edit.

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: The blocks before the edit.

fields.name: mentions
fields.description: The mentions before the edit.

fields.name: by
fields.description: The subject of the caller who made the edit.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When, in epoch milliseconds.

ReviewCommentsMessages.name: ReviewCommentsMessages
ReviewCommentsMessages.comment: On a table, one row per message of the row's conversation, keyed by its id: its thread and the message it quotes, its author, its state, its body, blocks and mentions, when it was posted and last edited, how many edits it has had, whether it is pinned, the clientId it was posted with, and for a top-level message who resolved its thread and when. A deleted message keeps its row; a purged one loses it. A delete of the row deletes them.

fields.name: review
fields.description: The Review row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The message's id on the row, from 1, in ten digits zero-padded so the key's order is theirs; never reused, a purged message's included.

fields.name: thread
fields.description: For a reply, the id of its thread's top-level message; absent for a top-level message.

fields.name: quotes
fields.description: The id of the message of the thread a reply quotes, when it quotes one.

fields.name: author
fields.description: The subject of the caller who posted it.

fields.name: state
fields.description: posted, or deleted once deleted.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The text, Markdown; empty once deleted.

fields.name: blocks
fields.description: The blocks as posted or last edited, in order.

fields.name: mentions
fields.description: The subjects it mentions, as posted or last edited, in order.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: When it was posted, in epoch milliseconds.

fields.name: postedAt
fields.description: When it came to stand, in epoch milliseconds: its post's time.

fields.name: stand
fields.description: Its place in the order the conversation's messages came to stand, from 1.

fields.name: editedAt
fields.description: When it was last edited, in epoch milliseconds; absent before its first edit and once deleted.

fields.name: edits
fields.description: How many edits it has had.

fields.name: pinned
fields.description: Whether it is pinned.

fields.name: clientId
fields.description: The caller's key for it, by which a retry of its post returns it.

fields.name: resolvedBy
fields.description: For a top-level message whose thread is resolved, the subject who resolved it.

fields.name: resolvedAt
fields.description: When its thread was resolved, in epoch milliseconds.

ReviewCommentsReactions.name: ReviewCommentsReactions
ReviewCommentsReactions.comment: On a table, one row per reaction a subject holds on a message, keyed by its number on the row, which orders reactions: the message, the emoji, the subject and when. unreact deletes the caller's; a delete or a purge of the message deletes them, and so does a delete of the row.

fields.name: review
fields.description: The Review row the rows are of; deleting it deletes them.

fields.name: reaction
fields.description: The reaction's number on the row, from 1, in ten digits zero-padded: the order reactions were given in, which listReactions pages by.

fields.name: message
fields.description: The id of the message reacted to.

fields.name: emoji
fields.description: The emoji: a name or the character itself.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: The subject of the caller who reacted.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When, in epoch milliseconds.

Ticket.name: Ticket
Ticket.comment:
A ticket's conversation (D77, D103's step 4): messages and their
replies, edits within 15 minutes of a post, reactions, pins and resolved
threads, each write beside the row, and a caller holding tickets.moderate
edits and deletes another's message and purges.
